create_dynamic_bandit_agent: create a DynamicBanditAgent using make_agent with a specified feature dimension for LinUCB policy
choose_action_bandit_agent: choose the best bandit arm action by calling choose_action with features of all arms
create_dynamic_bandit_env: create a DynamicBanditEnv with configurable batch size, arms per episode, and feature dimension
get_batch_cbinput: get a synthetic CBInput batch with arm features and rewards from the DynamicBanditEnv
track_reward_regret: track accumulated rewards and regrets by calling add_chosen_action_reward with the agent chosen action
